label: Post-absence well-founded grounding from well-founded grounding among present things
meaning: Strength order between two versions of the well-foundedness premise over the same history, Concrete predicate and grounding relation: things that come to be after a moment are present at some moment. The converse fails in control 7 (an endless past of grounds with no empty moment). The derivation of inert emptiness uses only the weak version. No premise is established.
